content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Realtor.com's PostRealtor.com Verified accountFebruary 11 · Shared with PublicDave Ramsey says the housing market is “clogged” and argues inventory won’t improve without policy changes. First, he wants to limit large institutional investors and foreign buyers from purchasing single-family homes in bulk, saying it keeps too many properties off the market for families.Second, he proposes raising the capital gains tax exclusion on primary residences from $500,000 (for married couples) to $2 million, arguing it would encourage equity-rich homeowners to sell and quickly boost housing supply.All reactions:1.4K327 comments90 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant AuthorRealtor.comVerified account Read more: https://rltor.cm/hDjqBCREALTOR.COMDave Ramsey Offers Trump a $2 Million Plan To Jump-Start the Housing Market, in Case He's 'Listening'Dave Ramsey Offers Trump a $2 Million Plan To Jump-Start the Housing Market, in Case He's 'Listening'9w1Rick DererAlso consider reducing capital gains taxes on investment homes. Freeze property tax increases for 5 years after primary home purchase. Allow a tax write off of up to 20% of down payment for primary residence.8w37View all 7 repliesDon FabrikantSellers that want to move are waiting due to rates. They have 3.0% now so why would they go into a 6.2% Trump did say they should be able to take the rate with them: pass that and BAM!8w14View all 2 repliesTony ManionIf homes are not selling, the price is too high. Very simple economics8w9View all 7 repliesLeeann WillockThe institutional investors will just spin off smaller entities to buy up the homes in bulk. Another idea is to fix the interest rates for single family owner occupied homes somewhere between 4-5% that would remove a lot of the major swings in the market. Also someone with a 2.875% mortgage would find it more palatable to sell their present home if they aren’t doubling the interest rate to get into a new one.
